categories.main_business_segments: ISU Petasys specializes in manufacturing printed circuit boards (PCBs), focusing on high-layer multi-layer boards (MLB) for electronic products. The company operates through its headquarters in Korea with four factories and research centers, and overseas production subsidiaries in China and the USA. It also has marketing subsidiaries in Hong Kong. The business is solely concentrated on PCB manufacturing and sales, with over 95% of sales derived from exports.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced PCB manufacturing technologies including ultra-high layer multi-layer boards, backdrill stub length minimization, coaxial PTH technology for high-speed transmission, and uses super ultra-low loss halogen-free materials. Production capacity is enhanced by automation and modernization of facilities, with ongoing R&D in 800G data center networking PCBs, AI accelerator PCBs, optical PCBs, and new materials for 6G high-speed signal transmission. Production is based on a 100% made-to-order system.
categories.primary_customers_markets: ISU Petasys serves global IT companies, particularly in data centers, network equipment, servers, AI accelerators, supercomputers, aerospace, automotive radar, and semiconductor testing equipment sectors. Major customers include leading data center and telecommunications firms, with two customers accounting for approximately 45% of total sales. The company targets high-end network equipment, HPC, 5G base stations, and automotive radar markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea, with production facilities in Daegu and overseas manufacturing subsidiaries in the United States and China (Hunan). It also has a marketing subsidiary in Hong Kong. Its sales are global, with over 95% of revenue coming from exports to regions including the Americas and other international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: ISU Petasys operates in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain as a manufacturer of core components—printed circuit boards—for electronic devices. It procures raw materials such as thin core, prepreg, and copper foil from suppliers and supplies finished PCBs directly to global IT equipment manufacturers and data center operators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in ultra-high layer PCBs, focusing on 800G data center networking, AI accelerator PCBs, optical PCBs, and new materials for 6G signal transmission. It invests in capacity expansion, automation, and quality improvement to maintain technological leadership. Strategic efforts include securing core technologies for AI accelerator markets and expanding production capabilities to meet growing demand in high-speed networking and data center sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of printed circuit boards on a 100% made-to-order basis. The company sells directly to global IT and telecommunications customers, with payment terms typically involving cash on delivery or credit terms averaging 60 to 90 days. Export sales constitute the majority of revenue, with domestic sales comprising a smaller portion.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: ISU Petasys is positioned as a leading high-layer PCB manufacturer in Korea and globally, competing with companies like Korea Circuit and Interflex. It holds a strong market position in high-end network equipment and data center PCBs, recognized for advanced technology and quality. The company is noted as one of the few global PCB manufacturers showing sales growth amid challenging market conditions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, ISU Petasys reported consolidated revenues of approximately KRW 675.3 billion, a 5% increase from the previous year, with operating profit of KRW 62.2 billion, down 47% due to increased costs from new plant expansions and reduced sales in high-margin network products. The company has a solid asset base of KRW 626.4 billion and equity of KRW 266.8 billion, with a debt-to-equity ratio improving to 135%. It maintains positive operating cash flow and is investing heavily in capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: ISU Petasys emphasizes its unique value through advanced ultra-high layer PCB technology, high reliability, and quality certifications including AS9100 and NADCAP for aerospace and defense sectors. Its specialization in high-density, high-speed PCBs for data centers, AI accelerators, and network equipment differentiates it from competitors. The company leverages strong R&D capabilities and global partnerships to deliver customized, high-performance PCB solutions that meet stringent customer requirements.
